summary.one_line: The clearer articles and retrospective diary preserve checked outcomes and limits without a confirmed documentation defect.

purpose.evidence: Read all 33 changed Markdown paths. Existing subject pages now lead with the reader answer or task: combat Start for coordinates, a bounded public-input table, a concrete marker override, and preview-card meaning. The new RU/EN diary records six experiments/corrections for process and results; it is explicitly a retrospective public journal, not a claim that all raw workshop notes were migrated. ADR is reserved for project choices, while game observations stay in the diary.

structure.evidence: The new diary pair starts with the record purpose and dated experiment entries, then places recording rules at the end. The empty wrapper headings from the first candidate were removed in HEAD 58b731d. Detailed terrain/movement/startup history moved from test-maps into the map-release diary record; the article retains practical setup checks. The duplicated Start code block was removed from placement and linked to the combat-scripts recipe. New nav/home/index and topical article links connect the diary to its evidence. Final HEAD 9d5e4a8 adds a prose lead-in before the terrain/movement/startup subsections, explicitly placing those three original-harness checks on September 21-23 before the September 24 public-map release.

specificity.evidence: Verified current tracked artifact hashes named in both diary translations: WorkshopPolygon.h5m is 10172 bytes with SHA-256 b5baf474cb523dfa9ec66831676d9c98c722198f1e8af017290d38ec38fa68dc; observations.json SHA-256 is 3865ebc7623a024edafc5f208834070916b0bf651e27f5f3e63ba01b64f0718c. Diary's elemental attempt table preserves Fire/Earth/Water/Air's seven candidates and three rejections from the existing public record. It preserves bank 15-slot ranges, CombatSize versus tier, unstable equal-score sorting, spread {0,4,9}, unreachable merge, and marker appearance/rollback without adding invented outcomes.

reproducibility.evidence: The diary links the public H5M, observations JSON, executable placement_walkthrough.py, diagrams, images and menu-marker packer rather than claiming inaccessible logs are attached. It labels the clean H5M menu launch, later failed captures and original marker log as unpublished/unverified where appropriate. Existing commands and code assets are unchanged except placement now points to the canonical combat Start recipe. Parent reports build, 8 Node/21 Python checks, 35 HTML, 12 browser tests and secrets passing. No new game run or full historical log reconstruction was performed for this editorial diff.

evidence.evidence: Compared diary outcomes with the previous public article evidence and tracked files: map release only claims archive checks, elemental trace remains seven attempts/four successes, pack_12 mode remains assumed rather than recorded, bank and placement corrections match the earlier research-backed pages, and the marker first-launch failure remains visible. Image-capture entry distinguishes retained photos from failed black/white frames. I did not independently re-execute native code, authenticate every archival claim or certify all 34 draft page bodies; this review checks the changed text and referenced public artifacts.

applicability.evidence: Both diary versions state September 21-23 entries were reconstructed on September 24, 2026, use the pinned Universe build unless otherwise stated, and disclose missing original logs. Current articles preserve limits: preview is experimental rather than universal, bank data give possibilities rather than hidden selected guards, Start timing is not an adventure-console call, and the clean map has not received a separate menu launch. The diarized experiments are not promoted to verified article status.

translations.evidence: Compared the RU/EN diary pair across all six entries: same dates, attempts, hashes, bank quantities, placement corrections, failed-capture caveats and marker result. The 13+ existing edited subject pairs mirror the changed lead/sections and topical links; RU/EN link targets and reciprocal metadata pass the reported site check. This is a substantive parity review, not a professional translation audit. Both diary languages add the same dated lead-in distinguishing original harness checks from the later public-copy release.

maintenance.evidence: AGENTS and CONTRIBUTING now require appending significant experiments and dated corrections to both diary languages; README points readers to diary versus topical articles. Rules say to retain observations rather than rewrite technical history, record important SHA-256 values, and use an ADR for a project decision with context/options/choice/consequences. All 33 review:info Markdown paths are covered. No source/artifact was edited by this reviewer; future diary facts still require independent verification before any status promotion.
